subject: Your at the point I was 8 years ago...
author: SUFFUR
body:
and I have been  looking for when it goes else where?

I thought I would be doing that, looking for the next media comsumption seller, but in truth, going else where is hard after being set playing same old same old, you know build a better shooter, see Halo 1 to 3, same game over all, just better processing power to give better graphics and user interface, the add of movies went with more space to save such data, and yes the engine for 3 is amazing for it to do what it all does, see I know nothing, no tech jargon at all, lol.

I though that Crackdown could have been the one to push the SandBox idea to it's fullest, I touched this on another post but I add more to this;

If Crackdown was 8 player (could be 16, why not 32, why do numbers double lol), ( I have not played GTA, but due to Game companies forgeting about Lefties, I can't refer to it, but do like alot about it) and you could do the same things but then bring out DLC so people could play, Basket ball. American Football, Soccer, Race, fight the bosses all at once, and the game could compensate for more players, with more enemies, plus add other side games, comsumer created, but through a test mod system and if it works be a proper download after testing by the creators of the original, and the sub game creator could even get paid too with MS points, if through the Xbox system.

I'm still waiting to see what APB with be like, on paper I want it!

Anyway I digress, finding an audience is the biggest fear, so comapnies make the same type of game over and over, some like Criterion, rather do something different, but still keep with in what they know, but to do something, like GH/RB, just going on the assumption, that people pose in front of the mirror with a tennis racket in their hands, air guitaring to their favorite songs, takes a risk ( a qouteish from said DICE summit video), and I feel after those DICE summit videos, is just make it and they will come because it's different because someone else made it. Portal a good example, now that  with multiplayer will be nuts ( and no I don't know if the new Portal has it), then think Crackdown again.

I use Crackdown as an example of a game that take several genres and puts it into one space, is this where Xbox Live will go to, you sign in and you are in a virtual world like real life (or Fantasy like WOW, Halo, Fable 2 etc), and you have a home etc, that you leave to go drive downtown to kill people in, or play football, or go Bowling or watch a movie, do you guys get this?

Anyway that is just one Vision.

Games are set within genres, FPS, racers... Criterion are trying to break the mold with Paradise, though more change it's shape for game play, but with the technology their are using and created, it will mean games will be played different, other games have done the same thing, but what is the next Big thing, that will unlock an experience that can't be put down, and does it have to be that good, that you could play it at anytime, but stop because you can.

I don't know once again where I was going with this as I was Multi-tasking to the Power of 6 and I'm a guy, so when my internet cut out I though, 3 less things to worry about, but now when do I stop writing, so I can back up this post, lol.

My head gets so full it explodes ( and yes i do live from the experience, lol), and all you guys get to see, is the front wall  part of the  explosion, which has all sorts of bits, with different colours and shapes, and even if you could clean up with collecting the bits in one place, in little piles, you're still missing the bits on 5 other surfaces, that I just forget about, as it becomes the art of my mind or interior of my skull, lol.

To Procrastinate, means I'm not doing much, maybe do lots, think less, then if one works, then think where it will go, and do work to put more in, sort of like Paradise is now.

No I'm a Philosopher, about a virtual thing, see History of the World, by Mel Brooks to see what a Philosopher get paid. LOL.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Rockband vs GH
author: Xandu
body:
In Rockband everything you download in RB1 can be played in RB2. This is part of Harmonix’s philosophy and they are basically building what they call a music platform. From what I have heard from interviews with Greg LoPiccolo it seems like Harmonix are trying to make it so that if you buy a song for RockBand you buy it once and you can then play it in all their games.

Neversoft on the other hand does things differently and you have to pay for and download your favourite songs in each version of Guitar Hero. Another thing that really surprised me was that you can’t use the RockBand guitar in Guitar Hero III. AFAIK there are no technical reasons that you should have to re-buy all songs for each version of the game. So it must be a money/licensing issue.

I think I prefer Harmonix’s ways of doing things as it seems a little bit more thought true.

-- The Creator --
